posts.title: ROBERT WILLIAM ELDER (1957-2026)
posts.description: Professor Robert William Elder came to Beloit College in 1989. From the beginning he demonstrated his capacity to make complex concepts in economics both clear and exciting. Students noticed and flooded to his classes. Few if any Elder courses have had small enrollments.
